author: Inside Edition
description: Halloween contact lenses may transform your costume in the blink of an eye, but the decorative contact lenses may come with frightening risks. One woman says she suffered a serious eye injury after wearing blackout lenses with her Halloween costume. Federal law requires a valid prescription to buy costume contacts. But INSIDE EDITION found stores selling them without asking for one. Now, an eye doctor explains how these spooky accessories could threaten your sight.
title: Are All Halloween Contact Lenses Safe To Wear?

author: Inside Edition
description: Chaos erupted at a town council meeting. The mayor was restrained as he headed toward an upset citizen who had given him the middle finger. The ruckus is getting national attention. It occurred in the council chamber of Pemberton Township, New Jersey. Mayor Matthew Bianchini tells Inside Edition he flipped out because he thought the resident was making a rude hand gesture to his wife and daughter, who were in the audience. Inside Edition also spoke with the citizen, Michael Sawka, who denies that.
title: Mayor And Resident Speak Out After Clash At Town Council Meeting

author: Inside Edition
description: No, the Dracula orchid isn't likely to suck your blood. But it is likely to go extinct, if people don't work to protect the species. "Dracula" means "little dragon" in Latin, and the flowers are so named because they resemble little dragons. Native to South and Central America, they're threatened by climate change and other human-caused issues. To help preserve Dracula orchids, the Chester Zoo in England is raising them, by recreating their habitat, which is described as "cool and misty."
title: Beware The Dracula Orchid!

description: Someone needs to alert Jamie Lee Curtis that now's the time to run and hide, as her nemesis isn't able to chase anyone. A KCBS helicopter caught this eerie scene while covering a flood in Huntington Beach, California. Someone dressed as Michael Myers from the "Halloween" movie franchise was seen paddleboarding through the affected streets. He wasn't so scary floating around with a rower to guide him. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Michael Myers Seen Paddleboarding Through Flooded SoCal Streets
